images.caption:
This photo was taken October 2005 at Monticello, the home of Thomas Jefferson, in Charlottesville, Virginia.  The reflection is from the fish pond where Jefferson would temporarily keep fish before they were prepared for meals at the house.

Photographer: Matt Kozlowski
